events.observation: Identity/interval starts after the saved no-GPS-request, mStarted=false idle dump.
VoiceInteractionManagerService announces restart of the selected Google voice interactor.
Wake key is delivered after both service restarts.
Kernel reports successful WMT GPS open.
Probe PID 9614 emits request log before registering its status callback.

conclusion: The saved idle snapshot was invalidated before probe launch. The interactor and HotwordService restart already precede wake, so wake/widget ordering alone cannot explain or prevent the observed restart.
request_owner_limit: The active location dump records renewed GMS GPS history. This excerpt does not directly name the requesting client at GPS start; Search-to-GMS ownership is inferred from that history and the observed service restart chain.
source_support: VoiceInteractionManagerService onHandleForceStop restarts a selected nonempty interactor; switchImplementation accepts an empty setting as no component and shuts down the old implementation. Other writers can still refill the setting, which the revised prelaunch guard checks.
